backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor with no logic.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing features, related files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Reference summaries for many frontend components and screens.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base/theme variables and global styles including light/dark OKLCH palette and viewport utilities.
frontend/index.html: HTML shell mounting the React app via root div and main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main screen-flow controller switching between six game screens with reset capability and audio toggle.
frontend/src/components/AudioToggle.tsx: Button toggling background music using useRomanticMusic with icon switching.
frontend/src/components/ConfettiBurst.ts: Generates 50 timed falling confetti particles that auto-clear after 4s.
frontend/src/components/DodgeMessageToas: Shows a temporary toast message below its anchor when NO button dodges.
frontend/src/components/Level1Distractio: Renders floating hearts, a walking teddy, and popping flowers for Level 1.
Displays teddy, flower, and chocolate occluders positioned over Level 1.
frontend/src/components/OutwardHeartBurs: Creates 12 outward-bursting hearts that animate then auto-clear after 2s.
frontend/src/components/TeddyHugJump.tsx: Shows a teddy with overlay heart performing a gentle jump animation.
frontend/src/components/ValentineScreenS: Layout wrapper providing Valentine background and optional bottom CTA layout.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages backend actor instance tied to identity with auto-refetching.
frontend/src/hooks/useHiddenNoButton.ts: Implements logic for a hidden, periodically relocating NO button and detects proximity taps to trigger escape events.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity auth context, managing login state, stored identities, and AuthClient configuration.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Placeholder hook returning no backend queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useRomanticMusic.ts: Manages a placeholder looping audio element with a toggle for play/pause.
frontend/src/index.css: Global Tailwind styles and custom Valentine-themed color tokens, utilities, and backgrounds.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with React Query and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/screens/ExtraCuteEndingScre: Displays final cute ending with a teddy image and a Replay button.
frontend/src/screens/FinalLevelScreen.ts: Renders decoy buttons that disappear when tapped and completes once all are removed.
frontend/src/screens/IntroScreen.tsx: Intro page welcoming the user and offering a Start Game button.
frontend/src/screens/Level1Screen.tsx: Gameplay screen where a hidden NO button relocates as the player searches, showing miss messages and completing after enough attempts.
Shows the final Valentine question with a single YES button.
frontend/src/screens/YesCelebrationScree: React screen that plays confetti/heart/teddy animations, cycles through sweet messages with timers, then shows a final message and triggers onComplete after a delay.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind config extending colors, radii, fonts, shadows, and enabling dark mode, animations, and typography plugins.
project_state.json: JSON snapshot describing the Valentine mini‑game concept, architecture notes, required images, and existing feature records.
